plugins.name: revit-journal-analysis
plugins.description: One skill, nothing else: read Autodesk Revit journal files and quote the evidence with line numbers - how a session ended, crash markers and dumps, licence and model-open errors, add-in loading. No MCP server, no hooks. The revit-bridge plugin already includes it.
